name: CICPolice
description: Procedure for the CIC Police watchdog. Each round: open claude.ai/code in the VM's Chrome (or local CIC for live sessions), pick up to 3 finished threads, leaf-judge each into Cat 1–5, post the exact fixed-wording reaction per category, report the round as a status table per refReporting. RAM-bounded to 3 threads/round. 10 min between rounds; cron is the heartbeat. Self-nudging is allowed — the 2-consecutive-nudge cap is the only runaway-loop brake.
author: GuildOS
